description: Logical entity as defined by the ER modeling standards

EntityAttribute.description: Describes any attribute that ends up stored in a database column.

label.description: Label of the object. Used as business-friendly name

goldenAttribute.description: Defines whether attribute makes sense as a golden attribute. Useful to remove useless technical attributes used for matching for example

i18ned.description: Indicates whether this attribute is internationalized (translated).

lovValidationScope.description: Scope for value in List of Value validation.

mandatory.description: Indicates whether this attribute is mandatory.

mandatoryValidationLabel.description: Custom error message displayed when a mandatory attribute is left empty.

multiValued.description: Indicates whether this attribute is a comma-separated list of LOV values

physicalName.description: Physical Name bound to this entity attribute, it is used as a base name when generating the physical database schema

searchable.description: Indicates whether this attribute participates to search.

valueSeparator.description: Specifies the value separator to use

anyOf.description: Basic entities do not have matching or consolidation capabilities
Records in entities using Fuzzy Matching are matched using a SemQL expression defined in a matcher. \n(Fuzzy Matching was formerly known as SDPK)

Records in entities using ID Matching are matched if they have the same IDs. \nThis matching  behavior is well suited when there is a true unique identifier for all the applications communicating with the MDM hub and for simple Data Entry use cases. \n(ID Matching was formerly known as UDPK)
IDs are automatically generated using a database sequence
IDs are automatically created using a UUID generator

startWith.description: Starts With Value when using Sequence for GoldenID Generation.

anyOf.description: IDs are manually entered by the user
IDs are automatically generated using a Semql expression
IDs are automatically generated using a database sequence
IDs are automatically created using a UUID generator

autoConfirmGoldenThreshold.description: With a confidence score strictly greater than this value, the matcher will confirm non-singleton golden records.

autoConfirmSingletons.description: Select this option to automatically confirm golden records composed of a single master record

mergeThresholdMergingConfirmed.description: With a confidence score strictly greater than this value, the matcher will merge confirmed golden records.

mergeThresholdMergingConfirmedWithNewMas.description: With a confidence score strictly greater than this value, the matcher will add new master records to a confirmed golden record.

mergeThresholdMergingConfirmedWithUnconf.description: With a confidence score strictly greater than this value, the matcher will merge unconfirmed with confirmed golden records.

mergeThresholdMergingUnconfirmed.description: With a confidence score strictly greater than this value, the matcher will merge unconfirmed golden records.

mergeThresholdMergingUnconfirmedWithNewM.description: With a confidence score strictly greater than this value, the matcher will add new master records to an unconfirmed golden record.

mergeThresholdNewGroup.description: With a confidence score strictly greater than this value, the matcher will create a golden record from new master records.

mergeThresholdRemergingPreviouslySplit.description: With a confidence score strictly greater than this value, the matcher will merge confirmed golden records previously split by the user.

useMultiIterationGrouping.description: Grouping will run one Iteration per Match Score

useTransitiveMatchScore.description: Use Transitive Match Score while computing Confidence Score

expression.description: Binning expression used to reduce the data set into reasonable buckets before execution of the match process

label.description: Label of the object. Used as business-friendly name

documentation.description: Documentation displayed in the documentation panel. Markdown syntax is supported.

color.description: Color used in the explain record and duplicates management graph edges representing matches between two records

condition.description: SemQL Condition for matching. When true, the two records are considered as matching with the match score.

matchOnExpression.description: Expression returning the child records used for matching.

matchScore.description: Match Score for two records matching according to this match rule.

usingMatchOn.description: Match using child records of the current entity records.

idExpression.description: SemqlExpression used to compute the id when Semql Id Generation is used

startWith.description: Starts With Value when using Sequence for SourceID Generation.

anyOf.description: Validates data both before and after consolidation

label.description: Label of the object. Used as business-friendly name

documentation.description: Entity documentation displayed in the documentation panel. Markdown syntax is supported.

dataEntryAllowed.description: Defines whether entity supports creating  and editing "Non Consolidated Golden" records authored directly in MDM

enableDelete.description: Indicates whether delete is enabled for this entity

entityType.description: Defines the type of entity and the technique used for matching records in this entity.

goldenIdGeneration.description: Defines how golden record primary keys are generated for fuzzy matched entities.

historizeGolden.description: Select this option to automatically historize changes made on the golden records for this entity. This history is retained according to the entity''s retention policy.

historizeMaster.description: Select this option to automatically historize changes made on the master records for this entity. This history is retained according to the entity''s retention policy.

iconUrl.description: Default Icon representing the records of the entity

physicalTableName.description: Physical Table Name used as a unique name to generate tables for base entities

pluralLabel.description: Plural label of the object. Used to distinguish between singular and plural instances of this object

primaryKey.description: An optional reference to an attribute that is the primary key, required unless the entity extends from another one.

sourceIdGeneration.description: Defines how records ID are generated in Data Entry workflows and integration APIs.
